about: Lines of code (js, mjs, ts, css, html, py) per area, with ~3% slack: tools/budgets.ts. An area over its budget fails lint; raise a budget only with a new reason describing its current contents and size.

..reason: The root holds the server entry point and the Vite, Vitest and Playwright configurations; Vitest sizes its forks to the memory its cgroups leave.

public.reason: The app's HTML shell loads its browser entry point.

public/css.reason: People's rows. The Account page's forms. Responsive Studio, phone disclosures, navigation and full-size tap targets.

public/js.reason: Patterns run in a same-origin Worker whose first module deletes what reaches the origin, and the relay's hung-layer probes live in a module of their own that closing ends. Export's shape and frame packing live in fseq.ts, where the export test runs them. People lists accounts to change their role, disable or delete them. The Account page changes a password and deletes an account once its looks are counted. Prepared blur kernels cache exact weights and sums, nearest-LED cells store flat coordinates, and integrated clocks cache repeated reads within a frame; the views load the rig the server names.

public/patterns.reason: Five retired patterns that kept looks use come back as hidden modules, three renamed -classic beside the presets that took their names. Streaks tables per-lane random values and Chase tables common strand ids in frame(), retaining exact fallback calculations outside the tables.

render-box.reason: Parent PID checks stop orphaned library-only bakes between frames, alongside deterministic IDs and streaming FSEQ output.

shared.reason: Shared schemas and pure rules define looks, API data, permissions and playback.

src.reason: A save may send a module as its library ref alone, the library-only check filling it from the library first. A stored module is its library ref: every read fills its code from the library, hidden modules too, in the order a saved module's keys have, and leaves out a bake (and its review) of other code and the review of a version whose code changed, which filters and updates see too; every write and import keeps none, setting the ref by exact file. People lets admins change an account's role, disable or delete it; a sign-in rereads the account after its password is checked, and a new look its owner. The server brings each data folder under the library-only rule once, backing up first and clearing the bakes and reviews of looks whose code moves (keeping a bake whose frames stay the same), stopping on a library file it cannot read, and reads historical library fingerprints, retired patterns too, to upgrade exact saved copies to current code.

test.reason: The relay's probes are covered closing mid-recovery, and the smoke checks the pattern worker reaches no storage, network or script loads. Browser specs that played broken modules now break the page's library instead, since looks save only library code; the box's fork bomb ends its own children and the test checks none survive, with no PID namespace to end them. Every library preset's .fseq on the Folly, the Studio's Export and the bake's file, is read back by an independent reader: header, LED channels, fps, frames and sampled frames. Saves of modules as refs alone (hidden ones too), the library list marking hidden modules, and look files without code are covered. Stored modules as refs are covered: reads filled, writes without code, refs by exact file and renamed entries, a library change clearing bakes and reviews (a rebake under way too), versions' reviews, and filters on what a read gives, and the library-only step keeping a look stored as refs. The library-only step on a data folder is covered: what it keeps, moves and drops, its backups, its marker, a dry run, bakes kept or cleared, an unreadable library, the dry run by default, and the server never running it. Deploys are covered release by release (build before switch, rollback, pruning, the lock) with stand-in npm and systemd. An account changing its password and deleting itself (against a stale check or sign-in, with previews made or being made) is covered over HTTP and in the browser. Per-account write-limit and look-size tests. Library-only saving and baking is covered on every path (saves, imports, edits of saved custom looks, composites carrying code, bakes from stored frames), alongside Vampire palette browser coverage atomic settings-file writes and the default rig; browser checks build the app once per run and wait on drawn frames.

tools.reason: Tools build and check rig, palette and rose-expansion data, enforce budgets, support development and backups, and benchmark rendering.
